a.text: Nymph, have you seen that bag of Oriron I set down by the door?
Nymph! My pushcart is gone again! Please, help me find it!
Nymph, can you... help me find a new job? I promise I won't ditch work again!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Slow down. One at a time!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: The bag of Oriron is in the lost-and-found box to your left. The cart is on the roof... Where else am I supposed to put it? The room's stuffed with your things!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: No need to thank me. Just look how long this queue is!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: And who's looking for wor—

steps.name: Frail Sarkaz
steps.text: Me! I-I need work!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: You, Li'l Brick?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Last time, I had to beg just about everyone just to get you a furnace-watching gig, and by the second day, you'd already sold the furnace rack to a smuggler...

steps.name: Li'l Brick
steps.text: Okay, fine. I know I messed up a couple gigs before.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: 'A couple?'

steps.name: Li'l Brick
steps.text: Just one more, I promise! I really want to work and take it seriously this time!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Li'l Brick
steps.text: Come on, Nymph, help me out, just this once! Nobody but you is willing to help me anymore!

steps.name: Impatient Sarkaz
steps.text: You stinking brick. You broke every window on the street, and you still have the guts to show your face here? Quit wasting Nymph's time! We're all in the line here!

steps.name: Li'l Brick
steps.text: Who are you callin' stinking brick?!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Knock it off! No fighting!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: It's lunchtime already. Let's all head home! Come back and line up again in the afternoon. I need a break, too!
The boisterous crowd disperses, and the area in front of Nymph's door is quiet once more. She rubs her exhausted face and sighs.
Nymph takes out a dry roll. Just as she is about to bite down, she finds a few people coming up to her.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Sorry, please come back in the aftern—

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Huh? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: Is that all you're having for lunch, Nymph?

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: Catch—
Mitm throws Nymph a can of stewed meat with Rhodes Island's logo. Skeptically, she looks at the expiry date on the can.

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: It's not expired this time!
A number of Rhodes Island operators appear behind Mitm and walk up to Nymph. Having not seen her for some time, they all greet her enthusiastically.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: What... What are all of you doing here?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Most Rhodes Island operators and patients have been transferred to the local offices per the Doctor and Dr. Kal'tsit's instructions. Wait... You didn't get the notice, Nymph?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: But my sis—Uh, HR hasn't told me. I guess maybe for confidentiality reasons? How long have you guys been here?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: We just entered the city. We took in a number of patients on the way, so we have more people with us than anticipated.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: I was figuring out accommodations for the extra patients we have, and Mitm said you could lend a hand.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Most of the Infected from the outside have moved into the city. There's very few empty houses left, but let me look around a little. I might be able to find a couple still.

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: See? I told you she'd be able to help.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: We're all Rhodes Island operators. We gotta help each other out.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: But I probably won't have the time today. There will still be Infected looking for help in the afternoon. How about tomorrow? No, not tomorrow, either. I have so many people coming here every day...

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: You're the kindest Djall in all of Kazdel, but you are so much less sharp than before.

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: You say we're all Rhodes Island operators who gotta help each other out. Wouldn't you say that work the other way around, too?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Right. It's Rhodes Island's mission to help the Infected, after all.
Nymph's eyes immediately light up.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Okay... Let me help you guys find a place to stay first! We'll meet up at the office later!
Nymph tears a page out of her notebook and takes a pen out of Mitm's pocket. She quickly scribbles something on the paper and sticks it to the door.

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: 'If you need help, turn left and proceed to the Rhodes Island office! —Nymph...' Are you sure they are able to read something this formal?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: That's why I drew the map on the bottom! I'm just worried that you won't be able to handle it when too many people show up.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Heh, I'm not worried about that. Nymph, you might as well send everyone who needs help to the office. There's so many of us, we can handle all of them!

a.text: Rhodes Island, have you seen the jerky I hanged from the rafters?
Hey you, how come my wound's bleeding again? All I did was touch it ever so slightly...
Is there anywhere I can find work in Kazdel?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Please wait on a moment.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Sorry, Nymph. Help me out, will you?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Sorry, we've had a lot more people in the city since you left last time. I should've warned you...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Maybe I should ask them to leave?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: No, that's not what I mean! I was just hoping you could hire a couple dependable temps to help us Rhodes Island operators help Kazdel's Infected.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: We'll follow Rhodes Island's standards on wages and meal stipends... This should be like a walk in the furnace for you, huh?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: You want me to recruit helpers? I mean, I know a couple people...

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: No, if we're going to do this, we should go by the books.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Like resumes, background checks, interviews... You used to visit HR a lot, didn't you? This should be right up your alley, right?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: (But my sister never taught me how to pick resumes—)

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Okay, I'll figure something out.

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: So heavy!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Thanks. I promise this is the last box of resumes.

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: These bastards were all screaming bloody murder when we tried to get them to take a couple literacy classes. Turns out they can all write resumes after you yell at them a bit?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Maybe it's because Rhodes Island's pay is just that competitive here. Let's see...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: How come these resumes are all exactly the same?!

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: Uh, maybe instead of writing their own resumes, they all looked at the same resume and drew what they saw?

spans.text: Uh, maybe instead of writing their own resumes, they all looked at the same resume and

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: But I taught them all how to write their names, so I'm pretty sure they at least... Okay, they copied that, too.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: If we sort everything into these categories, then out of these few big boxes, we should be down to just... four resumes. Sorry, Pohl. If I'd known, I wouldn't have asked you to haul all of them for me.

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: Well, the problem isn't the manual labor. It just kind of hurts to see all this paper getting wasted. Nymph, how about I give the resumes to Hoederer for his literacy classes, they can practice reading it?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Practice?

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: I mean, the stuff they wrote on the resume's not that bad. Like, look at this one.

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: Name: Brick. Yeah, his writing's not half bad. Experience: Brick brick...

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: Huh? Why is this entire resume just the word 'brick'? Is his name the only word he knows how to write?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Wait, Li'l Brick wrote a resume, too? Let me have a look... That's his handwriting, but given his background, I don't think Rhodes Island can hire him.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: What are we gonna do...? We can't trust the resumes, but there's so many of them... I can't interview all of them either.

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: You know, I think we can take this opportunity and scam... I mean, encourage all these job seekers to take some literacy classes.

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: You could interview just the few who submitted proper resumes and hire any suitable candidates per protocol. We'll call them 'Batch 1.'

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: Once the others figure out that knowing how to read and write is how you get a job, you'll announce you're hiring a second batch. I guarantee they'll all write their resumes seriously.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: That sounds like it'll take some time, but I guess that's fine.

steps.name: Mitm
steps.text: And now Hoederer won't have to worry about his literacy classes' revenue, hahaha!
Ugh... Nymph, there seems to be an issue with the resumes I brought to Hoederer.
What happened?
Anyway, you should head on over to Babel's office. Hoederer said he'll escort the candidate there himself.
Wh-What?!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Babel's office looks like it was renovated not too long ago either.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: But it looks kinda empty, and I don't see anyone inside.

steps.name: Wounded Feline
steps.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Nymph.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Hello! U-Um, your outfit...

steps.name: Wounded Feline
steps.text: This uniform is the only formal attire I have. Yes, I used to be a Victorian military officer.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Wow, I couldn't tell you were a soldier just by reading your resume. I heard Hoederer arranged for this interview?

steps.name: Wounded Feline
steps.text: I met Hoederer when I managed to get out of Victoria. He's an interesting man.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I'm sorry. Did you say 'managed to get out'?

steps.name: Wounded Feline
steps.text: What about it? Oh, you think Hoederer's keeping me prisoner or something? Haha.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: S-Sorry.

steps.name: Wounded Feline
steps.text: I lost my rank. Probably because I'd been helping Londinium's Sarkaz get out of the city. That must have pissed off a few people.

steps.name: Wounded Feline
steps.text: That's why I followed Amiya and left that country with the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I hope you don't mind me asking, but I want to know... What happened to your family in Victoria?

steps.name: Wounded Feline
steps.text: They're all gone.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Because of...?

steps.name: Wounded Feline
steps.text: Originium, and war.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I'm so sorry!

steps.name: Wounded Feline
steps.text: Let's get down to business. I am wondering what it is that you would like to hire me to do?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Your resume says you're fluent in multiple languages... There are a lot of Infected refugees in Kazdel right now, and they'll need all kinds of help.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: But most of the operators we have at the Rhodes Island office right now are Sarkaz. They know some basic everyday words, but it's not enough to help them fully understand the needs of Kazdel's new residents.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: They also wouldn't be able to discern the smallest differences in the descriptions of symptoms.

steps.name: Wounded Feline
steps.text: I see. Even the tiniest error in language can be a matter of life and death to a patient.

steps.name: Wounded Feline
steps.text: It would be my pleasure to provide language support for Rhodes Island's doctors, but I'm afraid I can't make any medical decisions.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: That's okay! As long as you're willing to help!

steps.name: Wounded Feline
steps.text: There's one other thing... and it's a little awkward to ask, but I will likely need your help to ask Hoederer for some time off. I'm afraid I won't be able to attend his literacy classes.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Um... You're learning how to read and write?

steps.name: Wounded Feline
steps.text: ...I'm his substitute teacher.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Sorry! O-Okay, it's a promise, then. Thank goodness. I still have time to interview the next person... Good thing I brought the resume with me.

steps.name: Wounded Feline
steps.text: Mind if I take a quick look? It might be someone I know.

steps.name: Wounded Feline
steps.text: Wait, him? He's very famous on the battlefield. Even I've heard of him. That's how infamous he is. You'd best be careful.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: H-Hello... Are you Mr. 'Metal Chain?'

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: Need something?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I'm in charge of hiring at the Rhodes Island office. You submitted your resume, so I'm here to give you an interview.

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: 'Resume...' I know what that word means. Asked somebody about it. Yeah, I handed one in, but what's an 'interview?'

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: It's um... a little investigation. I'll ask you some questions, and you just... um, need to answer them honestly.

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: Haven't I already put everything worth mentioning on the resume? Why do you need to ask me about them again?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Um, you wrote all about your achievements on the battlefield, and that's very impressive, but I'm more interested in the 'temporary housing construction experience' that you only briefly touched on.

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: Oh?
The mercenary stands up with his blade. Immediately, Nymph finds herself shrouded in his enormous shadow.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: U-Umm... If you don't want to talk about it, I-I'll...

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: You're interested in building houses, too?!
Nymph freezes. The mercenary in front of her is very... excited, like a kid who's showing off his toys to others.

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: How many are you going to build? How big's the plot?! What about the materials...? Never mind, that's the easiest part to solve.

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: Come on, spill it!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Oh, um... Okay! We're planning to build some sickrooms to house Infected in need of medical assistance. That's why I want to hire a foreman who has construction experience.

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: Foreman? I don't like gigs where all I do is boss people around.

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: But if it's for taking care of the wounded, then that's alright by me. I have a few brothers that I'll ask to help. You let us know how you want the houses. We'll figure out how to build them.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: That's great, but... We aren't planning on hiring a whole construction crew just yet...

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: What's that supposed to mean? You think we're in this for the money? They don't need no damn pay. Hell, you don't have to pay me, either.

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: I can't stand anyone who leaves the wounded behind on the battlefield!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: But this is not a battlefield... The war is over already. These are just sick people. People who came here from other places and happen to be sick.

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: 'The war is over...' Right.
The mercenary crumbles to the floor.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Are you okay, Mr. Metal Chain?

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: Where are these sick people from?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: All sorts of places. Places that won't accept them anymore.

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: And they don't mind coming to Kazdel and living in houses built by the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: To them, the houses might be their lifeline, and the builders of the houses are their saviors.

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: Alright. That's good enough for me. I'm taking this job.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Uhh... I guess the interview is... over, then?

steps.name: Infamous Mercenary
steps.text: How should I know? You're the one interviewing me.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: The last resume's address should be right around here. Knows how to treat patients... A farmer?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: But why is she still staying outside the city? I thought there were more patients in the city?
Nymph gazes at a hut a short distance away. There is a frail-looking Kuranta woman standing on a ladder and patching the roof.
A few children are nervously holding the ladder for her. All of them have clean bandages wrapped around their bodies.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Hello—
Noticing Nymph, the Kuranta woman sends the children back into the hut and climbs down the ladder before greeting Nymph.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Hello, Miss Gretel. I'm...

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: Hello, Nymph.

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: Is this about the resume?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Uh... Y-Yes. You wrote on the resume that you can treat patients. That's the kind of help we need at Rhodes Island's office right now...

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: I'm sorry, I lied. I can't treat anyone.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: But...

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: A few Sarkaz who can't write came here from the city and asked me to help him write a simple resume in exchange for some wheat seeds, and I accepted.

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: As for whether he sold the resume to others after that, that's none of my concern.

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: I can't treat anyone, and my name is not 'Gretel.' Sorry for having you come all the way here.
Nymph wants to say something. She can smell the medicine that's being brewed inside, and she saw the children's bandages.
But the Kuranta woman has already turned around.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I've met you before, haven't I?
'Gretel' stops in her tracks and shrugs.

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: I've met a lot of people. When would that have been?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: When I was still very small, I scraped my arm. You bandaged it for me... didn't you?
Nymph points at a child who is peeking through the door. On the child's ankle is a clean, white bandage tied up with a beautiful bow knot.
Nymph still remembers that light, beautiful bow knot. Just looking at it was enough to make her stop crying.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: You used to be a doctor at Babel, weren't you?

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: 'Used to.' Right, I used to be.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: You treated me, and you are treating other children now.

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: So?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: There are still lots of children in Kazdel who are waiting to be treated... and not just Sarkaz children.
The Kuranta woman turns around and wipes the sweat off her face.

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: I have nothing against Sarkaz children.

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: I just don't want to set foot in that city again.

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: The past is in the past. Everyone has their own choices. Nymph, you've known that since you were young.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I understand that... Thank you.
The Kuranta woman looks toward the hut and yells, as though reprimanding the children for not behaving.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: But I don't understand. You still live at the foot of Kazdel's walls, and you wrote your actual address on the resume.

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: You want to say that I didn't have to do this, right? Like I did it to help you find me?
The Kuranta woman looks at the recuperating children and smiles sincerely.

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: Since he promised to bring me some seeds, I had to let him know where I live, somehow.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: I am doing what Rhodes Island is doing as well. It's merely that I don't need another job that's in name only.

steps.name: 'Gretel'
steps.text: Goodbye, Nymph.
Nymph. Nymph!

steps.name: Li'l Brick
steps.text: There you are, Nymph! I put together a new resume! Please, take it!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Slow down. Sit down and relax... What's that bag in your hand?

steps.name: Li'l Brick
steps.text: It's a bunch of wheat seeds. I promised somebody...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: What?! So it was you who started those phony resumes!

steps.name: Li'l Brick
steps.text: N-No, I didn't!

steps.name: Li'l Brick
steps.text: I only know how to write my name, so I told that doctor everything and asked her to help me write my resume, but then someone stole my resume!

steps.name: Li'l Brick
steps.text: So I wrote my name all over another sheet of paper, hoping you'll help me once you see it.

steps.name: Li'l Brick
steps.text: But then I figured I ought to write everything down clearly to prove to everybody what kind of person I am.

steps.name: Li'l Brick
steps.text: So I went to the consultant guy, and he taught me how to write everything word by word. I came here in a hurry to hand it to you.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Let's see... Your name is... Gretel?!

steps.name: Gretel
steps.text: Right. The doctor gave me that name.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: If you know her, don't you know her address, too? Why did you have her put her address on the resume?

steps.name: Gretel
steps.text: I... I don't need another address.

steps.name: Gretel
steps.text: The doctor said I could fill in her address, and that she could help me if I ran into any trouble again... as a way to repay me for helping her out before.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: 'Help her out before...?' You mean you actually helped treat patients before?

steps.name: Gretel
steps.text: Yeah... I know I've messed up a lot. I just want to... make up for that. I've learned a lot of useful knowledge... Really!

steps.name: Gretel
steps.text: I want to help everyone, just like how you're helping lots of people. I want to help make everyone's lives better!

steps.name: Gretel
steps.text: Please! You don't have to pay me!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: That... That won't do.

steps.name: Gretel
steps.text: Wh-What?!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: What I'm saying is. Let's find another time for a proper interview.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: And it's nice to meet you again, Gretel!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ahh... my neck hurts so much... Now we're finally done with the employment contracts of the second and third batch of recruits!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I really don't get why my sister loves dealing with these HR documents so much. I just can't get the hang of it.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Well, now that I'm done, I might as well go for a walk outside.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: It's only been a couple days since I last came outside. How come this place feels so much more crowded?

steps.name: Sarkaz Resident
steps.text: H-Help! The scaffolding over there has collapsed, and someone's buried underneath!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I'm on—

steps.name: Rhodes Island Employee
steps.text: Coming! Quick, someone go pick up the first-aid kit at Rhodes Island's office!

steps.name: Sarkaz Resident
steps.text: Yeah! The doctor there will take some time to get here. Everyone, come help me move the rubble out of the way!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I'll—

steps.name: Sarkaz Resident
steps.text: Nymph? Don't worry about this. We're on the case. You just leave this to us.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Oh, okay...

steps.name: Anxious Old Woman
steps.text: Nymph, it's been days! You're finally back!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Hello, ma'am. Did you run into some kind of trouble?

steps.name: Anxious Old Woman
steps.text: Right, right! I've had this pet fowlbeast for the last couple years, and it disappeared all of a sudden the other day...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I'll help you find it!

steps.name: Anxious Old Woman
steps.text: Oh, don't you worry about that. Somebody helped me find it the other day. I just wanted you to have a look. Do you think it's gotten fat after its little outing?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Did the Rhodes Islanders help you find it?

steps.name: Anxious Old Woman
steps.text: Rhodes Islanders? I guess... not. Just an ordinary somebody who moved onto the street not too long ago.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Oh, okay...
Nymph spends some time strolling around the city. She runs into many who are in need, but she also runs into even more of those who are willing to lend others a helping hand.
It's not just Nymph or Rhodes Island who's helping others.

Finally, Nymph makes her way back to her house. On the door is a sign with a drawing of Nymph that she installed a number of years ago. Everyone who comes to her for help can immediately recognize it.
Underneath the sign is a sentence that reads 'If you need help, turn left and proceed to the Rhodes Island office! —Nymph,' which she added not too long ago.
She whistles happily and erases the text.
Then, she takes the sign down.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I never thought there would come a day when the people here didn't need 'Nymph' that much anymore, or that it would make me so happy.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I guess maybe I should apply to go on a few field operations and see what it's like outside Kazdel.
Nymph watches the pedestrians come and go. There seem to be many familiar faces in the crowd. She even thinks she might've spotted the Sarkaz named Gretel for a moment.
She greets everyone in the area, and in her heart, she quietly says a single word: 'Thanks.'
